legendaryActions.name: Legendary Action Uses
legendaryActions.text: 3 (4 in Lair). Immediately after another creature’s turn, the dragon can expend a use to take one of the following actions. The dragon regains all expended uses at the start of each of its turns.

legendaryActions.name: Cloaked Flight
legendaryActions.text: The dragon uses Spellcasting to cast In- visibility on itself, and it can fly up to half its Fly Speed. The dragon can’t take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Sonic Boom
legendaryActions.text: The dragon uses Spellcasting to cast Shat- ter (level 3 version). The dragon can’t take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Tail Swipe
legendaryActions.text: The dragon makes one Rend attack. Bone Devil Bone Devil

traits.name: Diabolical Restoration
traits.text: If the devil dies outside the Nine Hells, its body disappears in sulfurous smoke, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Nine Hells.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The devil has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The devil makes two Claw attacks and one Infernal Sting attack.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 10 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Infernal Sting
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 10 ft. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) Piercing damage plus 18 (4d8) Poison
